checks.name: Guide is labelled separately from AI

verification.browserQA: Blocked by browser access policy; not completed for this change.
verification.fullRepositoryLint: Existing checkout-page lint errors remain outside the chatbot change.
verification.checkout: No orders, captures, refunds, or rewards created in this audit.

limitations: Selected development suite used to guide fixes; not a holdout benchmark or general chatbot accuracy.
Same 100 prompts and original expectations; new structured checks also enforce percent rate, eligibility and budget basis.
90 independent requests and 5 two-turn sequences; context now matches the updated UI contract.
Live mode includes deterministic help/calculation answers; only responseSource=ai used the configured OpenAI model.
Assistant review of actual responses, not independent human usability research.
Backend contract tested, not 100 browser click-throughs. Browser preview was blocked.
Fictional catalog and estimates remain fixed at October 17, 2026; no real merchant offers or payouts.
